verdict.rationale: uv publishes an llms.txt index at docs.astral.sh/uv/llms.txt, served as text/plain with a quoted header, and every docs page can be fetched as raw markdown by appending index.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The probe 404s hit different paths (the domain-root /llms.txt and /uv/.md) and do not contradict the documented /uv/llms.txt location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that /uv/llms.txt and the index.md variants resolve, and any guidance written specifically for agents beyond the index.
